_note: Baseline re-record following the cover-band seed relaxation (commit 8c79574). Authorised on the numbers reported in docs/evidence/c1-live-attribution-2026-08-06.json, which are reproduced here as the before column.
adjudication: Authorised explicitly, with this justification: the gate passed against the OLD record only because that record is PESSIMISTIC on c1. A record that does not bind the improved values would let c1 silently regress back toward them without ever failing. Recording an improvement is still moving a gate's floor, so it is done deliberately and in the open.
why_the_record_had_to_move: c1_whitepaper improved on both lanes and nothing else moved. The gate PASSED against the old record, because a gate fails on things getting worse -- so an unmoved record is not an error today. It is a liability tomorrow: with the floor left at dy_p50 1.89/2.00 and within2pt 0.2812/0.1031, c1 could lose everything this change bought and still be green. Binding the improved values is what makes the improvement a guarantee rather than a coincidence.
method: GATE_BASELINE=update testkit/runall.py -- which clears the record and then gates the same run against the empty one, so its findings are informational and its exit code proves nothing -- CHAINED with a plain testkit/runall.py that gates against the record just written. Identical ceremony to the c9d36df re-record and the parser flip.

the_record_run._note: Informational by construction: gating against an empty record produces one finding per document per metric. Not cited as a pass.

the_verification_run._note: The run that proves anything: plain runall.py against the fresh record.

values_moved._direction_note: Every moved value improves. No recorded floor is lowered, no page match lost, no live-text change, and gate_pass_count is unchanged at 12 on both lanes.

defect_ids_survived: gate.save_lanes carries shortfall_defects across a re-record by design -- 'defect IDs are human knowledge and survive a re-record; numbers do not'. All entries are unchanged, and the verification run raised no stale finding, so every recorded shortfall still corresponds to a real one.
what_this_does_not_claim: That c1 is fixed live. This is the LibreOffice gate. c1's live blocker was dy_p50 21.91 in pass 6 and only a live pass can grade the fix.
That the offline improvement predicts the live one. The evidence file for the seed change records a STRUCTURAL prediction only, deliberately.
